fixShape: **Fix-shape (Phase 1, prose only — no edit here).** `StageTemplate` keeps the CSC triple (`col_starts`/`row_indices`/`values`), the column and row bounds, the objective and the two scale vectors (`col_scale`, `row_scale`), and sheds `n_state`, `n_transfer`, `n_dual_relevant`, `n_hydro`, `max_par_order`. The copy-forward block at `crates/cobre-solver/src/freeze.rs:158-162` goes with them. Nothing is relocated that is not already owned upstairs: `StateSpace` (`crates/cobre-sddp/src/lp/indexer/state_space.rs:97,100,104`) and `StageRowLayout` (`crates/cobre-sddp/src/lp/builder/layout.rs:509`) already carry the same numbers, and `crates/cobre-sddp/src/lp/builder/template.rs:445,459-463` is the only writer. Collateral the estimate must carry: the four StageTemplate test fixtures (`freeze.rs:275-279`, `trait_def.rs:380-384`, `backends/profiled.rs:252-256`, `types.rs` Default at 390-394) lose five lines each; the conformance assertions at `crates/cobre-solver/tests/conformance.rs:154-156` and the in-crate ones at `types.rs:779-782` and `freeze.rs:320-324` collapse; the test-only column arithmetic in `crates/cobre-sddp/tests/template_integration/penalty.rs:86` must source `n_hydro` from the engine-side geometry (`StateSpace.hydro_count`); the stale `n_dual_relevant` doc comment (`types.rs:282-286`) disappears with its field. **L0 purity test:** no engine concept enters `cobre-solver`; no dependency from `cobre-solver` onto an engine crate; no one-consumer abstraction is created — so this is `advances-1`, not `conflicts`. **Rejected sharpen variant:** renaming the five to neutral spellings keeps a multistage concept in L0 and sheds nothing.
